title: Prediction of in-hospital mortality risk in cardiac arrest patients using machine learning models: a study based on the MIMIC-IV database with external validation from Yunnan University Affiliated Hospital.
summary: Logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost and related models predicted in-hospital mortality in cardiac-arrest cohorts drawn from MIMIC-IV, with external validation at Yunnan University Affiliated Hospital. The results are limited to the reported models and cohorts; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
